BEGIN;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_seed_import (
    course_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES course(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    seed_scope smallint NOT NULL CHECK (seed_scope IN (1, 2)),
    source_slug text NOT NULL,
    source_file text NOT NULL,
    content_hash text NOT NULL,
    imported_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (seed_scope, source_slug)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_course_seed_import_seed_scope
    ON course_seed_import(seed_scope);

COMMENT ON COLUMN course_seed_import.seed_scope IS '1=test/dev seeds, 2=prod seeds';

COMMIT;
